verdict.rationale: Teams can check skills into a repository: Codex scans `.agents/skills` up to the repo root, and repo marketplaces serve as team-distribution sources. Skill changes therefore reach the team through normal version-controlled commits. However, published plugins backed by MCP servers pick up server changes automatically, with eligible updates going live after automated checks. That is exactly the behind-the-back update path the story wants to avoid, and nothing describes pinning it. Missing for 10: explicit version pinning for installed plugins or marketplace sources, a lockfile mechanism, an opt-out from automatic MCP-server updates, and independent corroboration.
